_meta.datasheet_section: p.1 Pin Configurations (UCSP top view, bumps on bottom); p.7 Pin/Bump Description; p.3 MAX9062/3/4 Electrical Characteristics; p.11 package outline 21-0789
_meta.package: 4-bump UCSP B4+1, 1.0x1.0 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, 0.64±0.05 mm
_meta.notes: MAX9064 = internal 0.2 V reference, NONINVERTING input, PUSH-PULL output: OUT high when IN > VREF (toc18). VREF 188/200/212 mV @25C, 185-215 mV over -40..85C; VHYS ±0.9 mV. 'T' = tape and reel, G45 = protective die coating.

pins.name: OUT
pins.note: Push-pull; high when IN > 0.2 V. Abs max -0.3 V to VCC+0.3 V.

pins.name: IN
pins.note: Noninverting input vs internal 0.2 V. Input range independent of VCC; stays high-Z when VCC = 0. No ESD clamp to VCC. Abs max -0.3 to +6 V, ±20 mA.
